newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 70,500 MT were down 42 percent from the week earlier, but up 29 percent from the 4-week average. The major buyers were Saudi Arabia (19,000 MT), the Netherlands (13,400 MT), Mexico (11,600 MT, of which 10,900 MT was rough), Japan (10,000 MT), and Guatemala (5,000 MT--all rough).

Exports of 70,600 MT were up 94 percent from the previous week and 45 percent over the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (30,000 MT), Mexico (11,700 MT), the Philippines (8,000 MT), and Canada (4,100 MT).
